Irrigation & Waterways Dept, Govt of Rajasthan 
 Letter of Recommendation
 
 LETTER OF RECOMMENDATION 
 
 Our ref: 24 31 Mar 2026 
 
 This office has engaged M/s National Infrastructure Corp. Ltd. for the work "Check Dam - Rajasthan Pkg-27" (Rs. 1952.00 Lakh),
 completed on 07 Sep 2023. On the basis of that engagement we record the following:
 • Adherence to the sanctioned programme of work and milestone dates; 
 • Quality of workmanship accepted at inspection without material objection;
 
 • Compliance with safety and statutory obligations on site; 
 • Responsiveness of the contractor's site management. 
 National Infrastructure Corp. Ltd. completed the engagement within the sanctioned time and cost, and their conduct on site was
 professional throughout. We would consider them for similar works. 
 
 Verification: Debasish Sharma, ee@dept.gov.in, +91-9830000000. 
 
 
 
 For Irrigation & Waterways Dept, Govt of Rajasthan
